scope.ledger_gap: restore_switch reads current and selected-backup workflow_runs, generation_jobs, revision_budgets and non-revoked approvals. Active runs, unresolved jobs (created/submit_pending/submitted/remote_pending/result_fetched/unknown/quarantined/approved), recovery claims, higher candidate budgets and missing/changed approvals produce RESTORE_LEDGER_GAP before switching. The source app.db is left byte-identical.
scope.snapshot_compat: every non-revoked approval checks_json is parsed and execution_snapshot_from_checks validates version, contract, encoding, digest, fields and constraints. Missing legacy snapshots keep legacy semantics; unknown versions or malformed snapshots produce RESTORE_SNAPSHOT_INCOMPATIBLE with the stable reason code and do not switch.
scope.preserved_facts: A selected backup containing a snapshot approval, prompt_candidate budget used=2 and an unknown generation job restores successfully; those rows and the exact checks_json remain after restore. Usage/slot floors still carry current acceptance counts forward.
scope.explicit_block: A refused restore creates no restore gate and moves no source directory. A successful restore still opens the 24-hour acceptance gate and requires CLEAR_RESTORE_GAP before new acceptance.
